mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_permission (permission_code, name, module, parent_code, created_at) VALUES (#{permissionCode}, #{name}, #{module}, #{parentCode}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT permission_code, name, module, parent_code, created_at FROM iam_permission ORDER BY module, permission_code
SELECT permission_code, name, module, parent_code, created_at FROM iam_permission WHERE module = #{module} ORDER BY permission_code
SELECT DISTINCT module FROM iam_permission ORDER BY module
